title: High-throughput DNA extraction for amplicon sequencing of infected plant samples
author: Sophia Haeussler
materials: Preheat water bath to 60 °C. Add RNase A (3 µl/600 µl volume) to extraction buffer. When samples were stored at -80 °C prior to extraction, we recommend taking them out a few minutes before starting as lids stick to the tubes very tightly when frozen. When thawed a bit, the lids can be removed more easily and do not break. We used Purelink RNase A (Invitrogen 12091039; Stock concentration 20 mg/ml).

steps.title: Collect and dry leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Collect infected leaf material and dry it.

steps.title: Prepare 96‑well bead plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 96‑collection‑tube plate (e.g., Qiagen 19560) and add one clean ethanol‑washed 4 mm steel bead to each tube. Tube holders may be reused and refilled with 8‑strip tubes (Brand 781525 with lids Brand 781535).

steps.title: Cut lesions into pieces
steps.instruction: Using sterilized scissors, cut 2–3 lesions per leaf (total 2–3 cm), chop into ~0.5 cm pieces, and place each piece into a tube, avoiding cross‑contamination (tape wells with laboratory tape).

steps.title: Seal tubes with appropriate lids
steps.instruction: Close each tube tightly with the corresponding lids (Qiagen 19566 for Qiagen 8‑strips; Brand 781535 for Brand 8‑strips).

steps.title: Freeze and grind tissue
steps.instruction: Freeze the sealed tubes in liquid nitrogen, grind in a TissueLyser II (Qiagen) at 20 Hz for 1 min, refreeze in liquid nitrogen, repeat grinding, and perform a quick spin‑down after grinding to collect material at the tube bottom.

substeps.instruction: Grind at 20 Hz for 1 min using TissueLyser II

steps.title: Store or proceed
steps.instruction: Store the ground samples at –80 °C or continue immediately to extraction.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl extraction buffer containing RNase A to each well, remove excess liquid from tube tops with tissue, reseal with sticky aluminium foil, and vortex thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µl extraction buffer with RNase A
Remove liquid from tube tops with tissue
Close plate with sticky aluminium foil

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in a 60 °C water bath for at least 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6200 g for 15 min (or 4000 g for 25 min if 6200 g is unavailable).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 350 µl of the clear supernatant to a 2 ml deep‑well plate (e.g., Axygen P‑DW‑20‑C). When using an electric multichannel pipette, set to manual pipet speed 1.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 350 µl clear supernatant to deep‑well plate
Set multichannel pipette to manual speed 1

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (350 µl) of 96 % ethanol, mix by pipetting (electric multichannel: pipet/mix speed 5, volume 500 µl, 6 cycles).

steps.title: Load filter plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µl of the mixture to an Econospin 96‑well filter plate (2020‑001, EpoChlifescience) placed on top of the deep‑well plate (compatible with AHN myPlate Microfilter Plate).

steps.title: Centrifuge filter plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6200 g for 2 min (or 4000 g for 5 min; this condition applies to all subsequent centrifugation steps).

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 450 µl of 70 % ethanol, optionally incubate 5 min if columns are clogged, then centrifuge at 6200 g for 2 min.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µl of 70 % ethanol (increase to 700 µl or repeat wash if contamination observed) and centrifuge at 6200 g for 2 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µl 70 % ethanol (or 700 µl if needed)

steps.title: Dry spin
steps.instruction: Discard flowthrough, place the Econospin plate on the deep‑well plate and perform a dry spin at 6200 g (or 4000 g) for 4 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA into PCR plate
steps.instruction: Place the Econospin plate on a 96‑well PCR plate, stabilizing the PCR plate in a 1.1 ml deep‑well plate (e.g., Axygen P‑DW‑11‑C).

steps.title: Elute with water
steps.instruction: Add 40 µl MilliQ water (pre‑heat to 55 °C optional), incubate 2 min, centrifuge at 6200 g for 1 min. Expected yield 200–500 ng/µl; increase water to 80 µl for higher total yield or keep at 40 µl for higher concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µl MilliQ water (optional pre‑heat to 55 °C)
